text:
The GTA 6 leaker is back. And he just dropped twenty-five minutes of footage.
His name online is Cyberleek. He leaked gameplay in August, then vanished with about two hundred fifty thousand dollars in crypto.
This week, his website posted a mystery poll. Two options, both hidden behind question marks. Voting closed today.
And then a file appeared. Three hundred sixty-seven megabytes. Cutscenes, missions, and story spoilers, according to early reports.
Here's the twist. Nobody has verified it. Rockstar hasn't said a word. And the game is six weeks away.
Rockstar called the August leaks heartbreaking. Take-Two went to court to find out who did it.
So here's my advice. Do not download anything. Fake files are already spreading, and some are loaded with viruses.
Heads up: this is a rumor. Rockstar has not confirmed it.
Would you watch the leak, or avoid spoilers? Tell me below.
